data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'Kinana' which means 'to keep, preserve or maintain'. This name signifies a mature and intelligent individual who is trustworthy and wise. In Islamic tradition, the name Kinana is also associated with the Prophet's companion, Kinana ibn Al-Rabi', who was known for his courage and faith. The name Kinana carries the meaning “Mature, Intelligent” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Kinana usually hope their child will grow to embody mature, intelligent and live with faith, good character and purpose.
